items.source: A NoRootNodeMappingException is thrown when the entity converter cannot find a node or map like structure that can be mapped. Nodes eligible for mapping are actual nodes with at least the primary label attached or exactly one map structure that is neither a node nor relationship itself.
items.translation: 当实体转换器无法找到可映射的节点或类似结构时，会抛出 NoRootNodeMappingException。可用于映射的节点是实际具有至少一个主标签的节点，或者是恰好一个既不是节点也不是关系的映射结构（即 Map 结构）。
